# INTRODUCTION

OUR APPROACH TO CORPORATE SUSTAINAB LITY

Our ESG Strategy and Goals

FINANCIAL CONFIDENCE

- Provide access to credit to at least 4 million individuals from underrepresented populations from 2021 through 2025
- Provide at least 5 million individuals with tools, resources, and educational content to improve financial well-being from 2021 through 2025

Our strategy is composed of three core pillars: Financia

Confidence; Climate Solutions: and Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion.

In 2020, we completed our first. ESG pricrity assessment to identify ESS issues of importance to our company and our stakeholders, which served as the foundation for our current ESG strategy and goals announced in 2021. We achieved a majority of our goals and continue to make progress on many others.

- Commit to net-zero emissions in alignment with the Scence Based Targets initiative (S810)
- Enhance the management of climate-related risks and opportunities across the business

- Provide at least $10 million to support initiatives, partnerships, and programs that address the adverse effects of cimate change and pollution on communities from 2021 through 2025
- Engage our colleagues in sustainability nit atives through the Green2Gether program

As 2024 will be the final year of our current strategy, and we intend to sunset the current goals in 2025, we have now commended a 'double materiality" assessment to assess environmental, social, and govemance topics, based on both American Express impacts to scciety and the environment and the potential impacts tol Amencan Express. This assessment is being conducted at the enterprise level and includes perspectives from several jurisdictions where we operate. The cutcomes of this assessment are expected to inform our refreshed Corporate Sustainability strategy and determine future reporting pursuant to the European Union's Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD).

- Double annual spend with underrepresented-owned suppliers in the US from a 2019 baseline to $750 millien in a year by the end of 2024, including increasing spend with Black-owned suppliers to at least $100 million annually
- Provide access to capital and financial education to at least 250,000 underrepresented owned small-and medium-sized businesses in the US from late 2020 through 2024
- Develop more inclusive marketing initiatives, as well as design and build product experiences and programs that better meet the needs of underrepresented consumer and business customers

The standards applied for this assessment considers views of materiality that differ from the definition of materiality applied for purposes of US securities laws on other legal requirements. See the About This Report section of this report for more information.

CLIMATE

SOLUTIONS

Empower individuals to build and maintain their financial well-being through products, services, tools, and education, while providing robust account security

Minimize our climate impact and manage our climate-related risks and opportunities

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

Enhance diverse representation,

equal opportunity, and an inclusive culture at all levels of the company

• Maintain 100% pay equity across genders globally and across races and ethnicities in the US

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

Strengthen the financial security and money management capacity of small businesses through

products, services, campaigns, and initiatives

• Support smal businesses, including by reaching $100 billion in spending by consumers at small, independently owned retailers or restaurants on Smal Business Saturday and during other Shop Smal campaigns from 2021 through 2025

Enable our customers and partners to transition to a low-carbon economy through the development

of new capabilities

• Pilot low-carbon product innovations, including carbon tracking and offset sclutions

Meet the needs of underrepresented businesses and consumers and develop more inclusive marketing initiatives

SUPPORTING DATA

Help build resilient communities through grants, programs, and initiatives that support economic empowerment and equity

• Invest 8500 million to build more resilient and equitable communities from 2021

through 2025

Support community programs and initiatives to help build more climate-resilient and equitable communities

Advance racial equality and social justice in our communities

• Provide $50 million in grants from late 2020 through 2024 to nonprofits focused on apdressing inequal ty and promoting social justice, including those led by members of underrepresented groups
